items.source: Writes the given source object into a store specific sink.
items.translation: 将给定的源对象写入特定于存储的汇。

items.source: Interface to write objects into store specific sinks.
items.translation: 用于向特定存储写入对象的接口。

items.source: T - the entity type the converter can handle
items.translation: T - 转换器可处理的实体类型

items.source: S - the store specific sink the converter is able to write to
items.translation: S - 转换器能够写入的特定存储池

items.source: source - the source to create an object of the given type from.
items.translation: source - 用于创建指定类型对象的源。
sink - 用于写入数据的输出端。
